gaps.term: rank budget identity s_b = W_b R - N + 2 L_b
gaps.quote: The network's rank budget, which counts dimension changes along its edges, gives $s_{\rm b}=W_{\rm b}R-N+2L_{\rm b}$
gaps.note: The rank budget is not defined or derived on the page, so the reader cannot check this identity relating the interchange count to the wire count, N and L_b.

gaps.term: direction of the bound s_b < W_b R
gaps.quote: The paper shows $N<2L_{\rm b}$, so $s_{\rm b}<W_{\rm b}R$.
gaps.note: Does not follow from the stated formula. With s_b = W_b R - N + 2 L_b, N < 2 L_b gives 2 L_b - N > 0, so s_b > W_b R, the opposite of the claimed bound. As written, the inference is inconsistent with the page's own identity.
